<div id="referencesubsetting-sysml" class="section">

# ReferenceSubsetting <span class="sd-sphinx-override sd-badge sd-outline-primary sd-text-primary">SysML</span><a href="#referencesubsetting-sysml" class="headerlink" title="Link to this heading"><span class="nerd-font"></span></a>

*<span class="pre">class</span><span class="w"> </span>*<span class="sig-name descname"><span class="pre">ReferenceSubsetting</span></span><a href="#syside.ReferenceSubsetting" class="headerlink" title="Link to this definition"><span class="nerd-font"></span></a>  
Implementation of <span class="pre">`ReferenceSubsetting`</span> defined in the KerML specification.

**Specification**:

> <div>
>
> <span class="pre">`ReferenceSubsetting`</span> is a kind of <span class="pre">`Subsetting`</span> in which the <span class="pre">`referenced_feature`</span> is syntactically distinguished from other <span class="pre">`Features`</span> subsetted by the <span class="pre">`referencing_feature`</span>. <span class="pre">`ReferenceSubsetting`</span> has the same semantics as <span class="pre">`Subsetting`</span>, but the <span class="pre">`referenced_feature`</span> may have a special purpose relative to the <span class="pre">`referencing_feature`</span>. For instance, <span class="pre">`ReferenceSubsetting`</span> is used to identify the <span class="pre">`related_features`</span> of a <span class="pre">`Connector`</span>.
>
> <span class="pre">`ReferenceSubsetting`</span> is always an <span class="pre">`owned_relationship`</span> of its <span class="pre">`referencing_feature`</span>. A <span class="pre">`Feature`</span> can have at most one <span class="pre">`owned_reference_subsetting`</span>.
>
> </div>

For language description, see section <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/refs/tags/2025-07/doc/1-Kernel_Modeling_Language.pdf#page=74" class="reference external" target="_blank">7.4.6.2</a> of the KerML specification. For more details on the model, see section <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Systems-Modeling/SysML-v2-Release/refs/tags/2025-07/doc/1-Kernel_Modeling_Language.pdf#page=205" class="reference external" target="_blank">8.3.3.3.9</a> of the KerML specification.

>
> </div>
